spec: secure-sign-service-rs workload request auth v1. Protocol authority is this Signer repository. Go callers must reproduce every hex field byte-for-byte. Isolated CI loads this file from CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/testdata/workload-request-auth-v1.json.

algorithm.unsigned_bytes: Neo N3 extensible serialization: VarInt(len(category)) || category || u32le(valid_block_start) || u32le(valid_block_end) || sender20 || VarInt(len(data)) || data. VarInt is Bitcoin/Neo compact size (one byte when length < 0xfd). sender is raw 20-byte little-endian H160 with no length prefix.
algorithm.sign_data: 36 bytes = u32le(network) || SHA-256(unsigned_bytes). This is what ECDSA signs. Do not call this a 32-byte digest.
algorithm.digest: SHA-256(sign_data). 32 bytes. The transcript digest= field is lowercase hex of this value (64 hex chars).
algorithm.canonical_transcript:
UTF-8, LF (0x0a) separators, no trailing newline: v1
method=/servicepb.SecureSign/SignExtensiblePayload
network=<u32 decimal>
nonce=<lowercase hex>
not_after=<unix decimal>
digest=<lowercase hex SHA-256>
workload_id=<id>
workload_role=consensus

incompatible_fura_note: neo-os-fura neo3fura_neogo_patch/securesign/contract.go PayloadDigest hashes u64be(len)||category || u64be(len)||sender || u64be(len)||data and omits valid_block_start/valid_block_end. That digest is recorded only to prove incompatibility. Do not use it.
